    def query(self, *, where: Expression | str | None = None, select: str | int | F | Sequence[str | int | F] | None = None, order_by: str | int | F | Sequence[str | int | F] | None = None, page_size: int = 1000, limit: int | None = None) -> AsyncRecordIterator
    async def query_page(self, *, where: Expression | str | None = None, select: str | int | F | Sequence[str | int | F] | None = None, order_by: str | int | F | Sequence[str | int | F] | None = None, top: int = 100, skip: int = 0) -> Page
    async def relationships(self, *, refresh: bool = False) -> list[Relationship]
    def report(self, name_or_id: str) -> 'AsyncReport'
